answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 155749 Country: India Title: I mostly go after every Friday namaz to my father's grave. Is it sunnah or bida’h? Question: I mostly go after every Friday namaz to my father's grave. Is it sunnah or bida’h? Answer ID: 155749 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 212/185/B=2/1439) You may go. However, it is better if you go there early on Friday after Fajr or after Ishraq salah or after Jumuah salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
